_lee_esto: Las obras de AUTORIA PROPIA. No salen de Webflow ni de Sanity: son contenido nuestro, y este fichero es su UNICA fuente. Lo leen cinco sitios y por eso vive aqui y no repetido en cada uno: las 5 fichas de src/pages/project/, la inyeccion de tarjetas de scripts/build-paginas.mjs (OBRAS_EN), los slides de src/pages/index.astro, la derivacion del bloque declarado de scripts/check-texto.mjs (OBRAS_PROPIAS_EN) y las urls de scripts/check-seo.mjs (PARTES_PROPIAS).
_ojo: El ORDEN de este array es el orden en que salen en /projects y en el carrusel del home, delante de las 10 del origen. Cambiarlo aqui las mueve en los dos sitios a la vez, que es justo lo que se queria.
_receta: Los AVIF los produjo scripts/importar-obras-propias.mjs, que guarda que foto de origen, en que posicion y con que recorte. Aqui esta el RESULTADO; alli, la receta.

obras.titulo: Luxury Pool & Raised Spa with Travertine Deck
obras.tituloFicha: Luxury Pool & Raised Spa Project in South Florida
obras.resumen: This South Florida project pairs a rectangular pool with a raised spa finished in deep blue glass mosaic that spills into the main body of water. A wide travertine deck, a full-length sun shelf and poolside basketball hoops turn the backyard into a space built for daily family use.

seo.titulo: Luxury Pool & Raised Spa Project | South Florida
seo.descripcion: Custom South Florida pool with a raised glass-mosaic spa, spillway, sun shelf and travertine deck, built for year-round family outdoor living.

galeria.alt: Rectangular pool with a raised blue glass mosaic spa spilling into the water, framed by a travertine paver deck in a South Florida backyard.

obras.titulo: Estate Pool & Spa with Sun Shelf
obras.tituloFicha: Estate Pool & Spa Project in North Florida
obras.resumen: Set on open acreage in North Florida, this project centers on a large geometric pool with a full-width sun shelf and a raised spa. The marble-look deck is banded with a dark stone inlay and a river-rock border that traces the entire perimeter.

seo.titulo: Estate Pool & Spa with Sun Shelf | North Florida
seo.descripcion: Large geometric pool with a sun shelf, raised spa and banded marble deck on open North Florida acreage, designed and built for estate-scale outdoor living.

obras.titulo: Pool & Raised Spa with Marble Deck
obras.tituloFicha: Pool & Raised Spa with Marble Deck in South Florida
obras.resumen: A South Florida backyard organized around a clean rectangular pool, a broad entry shelf with in-pool loungers and a raised spa clad in white tile. Large-format marble pavers carry the same light tone from the covered lanai out to the edge of the lawn.

seo.titulo: Pool & Raised Spa with Marble Deck | South Florida
seo.descripcion: South Florida pool with a tanning shelf, in-pool loungers and a white-tiled raised spa, finished with large-format marble pavers throughout the deck.

obras.tituloFicha: Luxury Pool, Spa & Aluminum Pergola in South Florida
obras.resumen: This South Florida project combines a custom pool and raised spa with a slatted aluminum pergola that shades the full length of the lanai. Glass mosaic tile lines the spa and the pool waterline, and deck jets arc over the shallow end.

seo.descripcion: South Florida pool and raised spa with glass mosaic tile, deck jets and a slatted aluminum pergola shading the lanai, by licensed pool builders.

obras.tituloFicha: Aluminum Patio Cover & Pool Deck in South Florida
obras.resumen: A South Florida outdoor living project built around a solid-roof aluminum patio cover that runs the full width of the rear elevation. The structure shades the sliding glass doors and the lounge area while leaving the marble deck and the pool open to the sky.

seo.descripcion: Solid-roof aluminum patio cover and marble pool deck for a South Florida home, shading the lanai while leaving the pool open to the sky.
